senses.sense_definition: A dedicated follower, attendant, or assistant to an important person.

examples.text: The professor was always accompanied by an eager <w>acolyte</w> ready to take notes.
He surrounded himself with devoted <w>acolytes</w> who supported his controversial vision.

senses.sense_definition: A person who assists a priest in a religious service, typically by carrying candles or incense; an altar server.

examples.text: The young <w>acolyte</w> walked ahead of the priest carrying a lit candle.
Two <w>acolytes</w> stood silently by the altar throughout the Sunday service.

senses.sense_definition: In the Roman Catholic Church, a person who has received the highest of the minor orders.

examples.text: Before his ordination as a deacon, he served faithfully as an <w>acolyte</w>.
The duties of an <w>acolyte</w> historically included assisting higher clergy at Mass.
